scope: Shared category editor, Flutter category renderer, category settings validation, and central web preview. No Android APK or iOS artifact built in this change.
root_cause: The central category editor reused captured merchant rows rather than rebuilding from the current connected store. A transient initial catalog failure also left an empty editor until reload.
square_cards: Two columns; card height follows width unless explicitly overridden. Images preserve their aspect ratio.

catalog.source: Current connector category_items, not captured rows or merchant name filtering
catalog.refresh: Accepts same-origin parent catalog updates, preserves draft names, visibility, custom artwork and hierarchy, and removes controls for records no longer supplied by the connector. A failed empty refresh retains existing records.

validation.flutter_category_and_catalog_tests: 9 passed; includes six layouts, square two-column geometry, three-level inline and separate-page navigation
validation.other_flutter_preview_tests: 5 passed; category overrides, checkout preview and auth preview
validation.javascript_tests: 16 passed; category isolation and recovery plus existing auth, commerce and preview interaction checks
validation.php: Category store and endpoint tests passed; connector PHP lint passed
validation.publisher: Upgrade from v1 and idempotency verified; generated frame JavaScript syntax checked; current live file fingerprints verified before activation
validation.browser: All six designs inspected, real category rows verified, inline and separate-page subcategories exercised, square selection saved and reloaded
validation.concurrency: Existing page-controls-6a1ecc9a4025.js retained. Other working checkouts and generated unrelated files were not committed.

limitations: Cross-store isolation is covered with distinct merchant fixtures. This change does not claim a new end-to-end checkout test for every ecommerce platform.
